test_title: PYST 22: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 19 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Digital literacy is now essential for human development in the knowledge economy. Which programme was launched to promote digital literacy among rural citizens in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PMGDISHA**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Gramin Digital Saksharta Abhiyan (PMGDISHA):** Launched by the Government of India under the **Digital India programme**, PMGDISHA aims to make **six crore rural households digitally literate** by covering one member from each household.
 
• It focuses on empowering rural citizens with **basic digital literacy** skills to operate computers, digital devices, and access various online services like banking, healthcare, and education. *Hence, the statement is correct.*
 
• This initiative is implemented by the **Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)**. It is specifically targeted towards rural citizens, ensuring that they are equipped to participate in the evolving **knowledge economy**.
 
• PMGDISHA aims to bridge the **digital divide** in India, especially among rural communities, by providing training on using computers and accessing the internet. It also enables individuals to access government schemes and services online. *Hence, this addresses digital literacy effectively.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **BharatNet:**

 
 
• **BharatNet** is a flagship programme aimed at providing high-speed broadband connectivity to rural areas. It is not directly focused on digital literacy but rather on internet infrastructure development.
 
• Under BharatNet, optical fiber networks have been laid to connect **Gram Panchayats** across India, enabling access to internet services.
 
 
 
• **Digital India:**
 
 
• **Digital India** is a broader initiative launched in **2015** with the aim of transforming India into a digitally empowered society and knowledge economy.
 
• It encompasses various programmes, including PMGDISHA, to promote digital infrastructure, digital literacy, and e-governance.
 
 
 
• **PM-WANI:**
 
 
• **PM-WANI** (Prime Minister Wi-Fi Access Network Interface) is an initiative to provide affordable internet access to all citizens through public Wi-Fi hotspots.
 
• While PM-WANI increases access to the internet, it is not specifically designed to promote digital literacy among rural citizens.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Key Features of PMGDISHA:**

 
 
• Target audience includes **rural citizens**, with a focus on marginalized communities such as **Scheduled Castes (SC)**, **Scheduled Tribes (ST)**, **Below Poverty Line (BPL)**, and minorities.
 
• The programme is designed to teach individuals how to use **smartphones, computers, and tablets**, along with access to digital payments and e-governance services.
 
 
 
• **Overall Impact:**
 
 
• PMGDISHA plays a crucial role in enhancing **digital inclusion**, thereby improving the socio-economic status of rural citizens.
 
• The programme aims to foster a **digitally empowered India**, where every citizen can contribute to the knowledge economy.
